statement: 2.1 Core Invariants & Goals: **G-2 (Universal Bracket Normalization):** Support unwrapping for all standard e-commerce namespaces (`contact`, `customer`, `properties`, `attributes`, `fields`, `account`, `order`, `lead`) as well as multi-bracket and array syntax (`services[]`).

statement: 2.1 Core Invariants & Goals: **G-3 (Zero-Trust Prototype Pollution Defense):** Guarantee that no input key—whether flat, bracket-encoded, or nested—can pollute object prototypes (`__proto__`, `constructor`, `prototype`) across both Node.js server ingress and browser JavaScript.

statement: 2.1 Core Invariants & Goals: **G-4 (Bi-directional Name Synthesis):** Automatically synthesize full names (`[last_name, first_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ')`) from Vietnamese/English name parts on both client storefront JS and server ingress for direct API submissions.
subject: 2.1 Core Invariants & Goals

statement: 2.1 Core Invariants & Goals: **G-5 (Unified CRM Presentation):** Standardize lead preview extraction across Dashboard, Inbox Table, Kanban Board, and Detail Drawer using a unified, centralized `extractLeadPreview()` utility with expanded Vietnamese/English dictionaries.
